# Ahmed Ibrahim Asl

> Portfolio of Ahmed Ibrahim Asl, an Embedded Systems & IoT R&D Engineer, teaching assistant, and technical educator based in Egypt.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://eng-asl.com/): Overview of Ahmed's embedded systems, IoT, robotics, research, teaching work, and free engineering tools.
- [Work](https://eng-asl.com/work/): Embedded firmware, robotics, IoT telemetry, secure hardware, OTA management, Flutter, and interface projects.
- [About](https://eng-asl.com/about/): Experience, university teaching, technical capabilities, publications, CV, and workshops.
- [Engineering notes](https://eng-asl.com/notes/): Published engineering field notes, Linux and cybersecurity walkthroughs, and the Learn With Me series.
- [Tools](https://eng-asl.com/tools/): Searchable electronics calculators and guided engineering workbenches.
- [Contact](https://eng-asl.com/contact/): Email and professional profiles.

## Free engineering tools

- [Guided workbenches](https://eng-asl.com/tools/category/workbenches/): Project generators, academic planning, control simulation, embedded code, security commands, and battery estimation.
- [Circuit design tools](https://eng-asl.com/tools/category/circuit-design/): Interactive calculators for circuits, component values, timing, power supplies, and control logic. Models, assumptions, and limitations are explained on individual tool pages.
- [Text and encoding tools](https://eng-asl.com/tools/category/text-encoding/): ROT transformations plus ASCII and hexadecimal conversions with worked examples.
- [Unit conversion tools](https://eng-asl.com/tools/category/conversions/): Temperature and capacitance converters with explicit units and assumptions.
- [Number-system tools](https://eng-asl.com/tools/category/number-systems/): Binary, hexadecimal, complements, shifts, and multi-base conversion tools.
- [Physics and math tools](https://eng-asl.com/tools/category/physics-math/): Motion, force, wavelength, frequency, percentages, roots, and logarithm calculators.
- [Gradify](https://eng-asl.com/tools/gradify/): University GPA calculation and a Delta Engineering transcript and graduation planner.
- [Model Mission](https://eng-asl.com/tools/ai-script-generator/): Guided computer vision project builder with YOLO26, YOLOE open-vocabulary detection, monocular depth, and U-Net segmentation examples.
- [Sensor Code Generator](https://eng-asl.com/tools/sensor-code-generator/): Arduino, ESP-IDF, and PlatformIO code for sensors, I2C, SPI, UART, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, ESP-NOW, and other embedded interfaces.
- [PID Simulator](https://eng-asl.com/tools/pid-simulator/): Interactive proportional, integral, and derivative controller tuning.
- [Battery Life Estimator](https://eng-asl.com/tools/battery-estimator/): ESP32 runtime and average-current estimates from active and sleep duty cycles.
- [Security Mission](https://eng-asl.com/tools/security-command-builder/): Guided command builder for authorized security labs.

## Areas of work

- Embedded firmware in C and C++ for ESP32, ESP8266, Arduino, and AVR systems.
- IoT architecture, device connectivity, telemetry, networking, Linux, and Python.
- Robotics, sensor integration, secure access systems, and remotely operated vehicles.
- Flutter control interfaces, UI and UX design, and technical communication.
- University teaching in satellite communication, acoustics, digital and logic circuits, measurement, and sensors.

## Writing series

- OverTheWire Bandit walkthroughs: Linux, SSH, files, permissions, processes, and networking.
- Learn With Me: Linux, Python, Dart and Flutter, and Git.
